title: IIT Bhubaneswar Notification 2026 - Apply for Assistant Executive Engineer Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar (IIT Bhubaneswar) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of Assistant Executive Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can use this chance and apply for the IIT Bhubaneswar Notification 2026 .
